description: The repository that holds this record asks the authority to associate it for one contract: the proof that the subject DID of a com.publicdomainrelay.temp.compute.events.guest.requesterDid event controls this repository. Record key: <service>-<authority with : replaced by ->.

authority.description: The DID asked to write the association.

service.description: The role the association is asked for.

contract.description: The authority's market.accept of the contract whose guest runs this repository's requester.

nonce.description: The nonce the authority put into that contract's secrets bundle.
